note: No gates: every course leg targets exactly one mark, except the last, which targets start_finish. no_cross_lines are for breach detection only and are never leg targets. Mosman (14, 13) is absent on purpose, see DESIGN.md section 6.

start_finish.name: PFSYC start / finish line

inner.name: PFSYC start inner
inner.note: The register has no row for a PFSYC inner start mark; this one is digitized in the QGIS layer.

start_finish.warning: club-32a is also a mid-course mark in most courses, so boats cross this line repeatedly while racing. Arm finish detection only after the final leg completes.

no_cross_lines.name: Bricklanding
no_cross_lines.note: Sailing instructions, Navigation Marks: boats that are racing are not permitted to cross an imaginary line between Bricklanding A and Bricklanding B. Both marks are rounded to starboard, one leg each.

no_cross_lines.name: Smith / Lucky Bay
no_cross_lines.note: Sailing instructions, Navigation Marks: boats that are racing are not permitted to cross an imaginary line between Smith Buoy and Lucky Bay Buoy. Both marks are rounded to port, one leg each.
